Name of Post:
																		
																		
																		NBE NEET PG 2026 Online Form
																		
																	
																	
																		Post Date:
																		01 July 2026 | 07:36 PM
																	
																	
																		Short Information :
																		
																		National Board of Examination in Medical Science (NBE) has Released Official Notification for Online Application form for the National Eligibility Cum Entrance Test NEET PG 2026 for admission to various MD/MS and PG Diploma Courses 2026-27. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to NEET PG 2026 Admission . Online Apply Start On July 1, 2026 & Last Date is July 21, 2026 .All Eligible & Interested Candidate Can Read the Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in The Given Link Below
																		
																	
																
															
															 

															
																
																	
																		
																		National Board of Examination in Medical Science (NBE)

																		National Eligibility Cum Entrance Test (NEET PG-2026)
																		
																	
																	
																		WWW.RESULTBHARAT.COM
																	
																	
																		
																		Important Dates

																		
																			Online Apply Start on : 01 July 2026
																			Last Date for Apply: 21 July 2026 (11:55 PM)
																			Last Date Online Payment : 21 July 2026
																			Online Correction : 25-28 July 2026
																			Final Edit Window to rectify deficient/Incorrect Images : 31 July to 10 August 2026
																			Exam City Available : 11 August 2026
																			Admit Card Available : 27 August 2026
																			NEET PG 2026 Exam Date : 30 August 2026
																			Result Declared : 30 September 2026 (Tentative)
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Application Fee 

																		
																			General/ OBC/ EWS  : Rs. 3500/-
																			SC/ ST/ PH Candidates : Rs. 2500/-    
																			Payment Mode: Pay the Examination Fee Through Pay the Exam Fee Through Online Debit Card, Credit Card or Net Banking Fee Mode or Fee Mode. 
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Course Details

																		
																			Admission to MD/MS/PG Diploma Courses: 2026-27 session
																			Admission to Post MBBS DNB/ DrNB and NBEMS Diploma Courses-2026-27 session
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Eligibility Criteria NEET-PG 2026
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		
																			Possess MBBS degree or Provisional MBBS Pass Certificate recognized as per the provisions of the NMC Act, 2019 and the Post Graduate Medical Education Regulations, 2023,  and
																			
																			Possess Permanent or Provisional registration certificate of MBBS qualification issued by the National Medical Commission (NMC) / the erstwhile Medical Council of India (MCI) or State Medical Council,  and have completed one year of internship or are likely to complete the internship on or before 30-09-2026.
																			
																			
																			Candidates found to be ineligible at any stage of NEET-PG 2026 will not be permitted to appear in the examination and / or counseling. In an unlikely event of any ineligible candidate appearing and / or being successful in the NEET-PG 2026, the results / candidature of such candidate shall be cancelled and / or are deemed to be cancelled.
																			
																			
																			Requests for appearing in NEET-PG 2026 from candidates completing internship after 30-09-2026 or having qualifications that are not recognized as per the NMC Act, 2019 and the repealed IMC Act, 1956 shall be summarily rejected. Candidates are further advised not to canvass for the same.
																			
																		

							
																		
																	 
																	
																	
																															
															
															Image Upload Instructions

															Passport Size Photo:  

															
																Photograph is in colour with white background.
																Your face is clearly visible.
																The size of image should be less than 80kb. Size of the image can be checked by right click on the image and then go to “Properties” link. (Maintain aspectratio, i.e. height and width ratio to avoid distortion of image)
																Image is in .jpg/.jpeg format.
																Image is not blurred in the process of editing.
																Digital enhancement or other alterations or retouching are not permitted.
																Make sure your face takes up at least 70-80% of the frame.
															

															 

															Scanned Signature

															
																The candidate should provide his/her complete signatures and not just initials.
																The signatures should be done by the candidates only as it may be checked any time frequently.
																Signature done on the blank white page without lines only will be accepted
																Take the white sheet and mark the box size of 3.5 x 1.5 cm (width x height)
																Sign inside the box with blue/black pen.
																If the Candidate’s signature on the answer script, at the time of the examination, does not match the signature on the Attendance Sheet, the candidate will be disqualified.
																Set the scanner to 200 dpi
																The scanned image should be saved in .jpeg/.jpg format.
																Crop only box area and not the complete white page.
																The size of image should be less than 80kb
															

															Left Thumb Impression: 

															
																Set the scanner to 200 dpi.
																Save the scanned image of thumb-print as .jpg/.jpeg format.
																Crop only box area.
																The size of image should be less than 80kb. Size of the image can be checked by right click on the image and then go to “Properties” link.
															
															
														
														
															
															Help Desk for NEET PG 2026

															
																Helpline Number: +91-7996165333 
																Helpline Portal: (i) For queries related to application form submission/ Refund of failed transactions/ Payment Gateway related issues etc: Portal can be accessed through applicant login after registering an application for NEET-PG 2024. (ii) For queries related to Eligibility/ Documents/ Images: NBEMS Communication Web Portal accessible through NBEMS Website (Contact Us tab)
															
															
														
														
														
    
        
        📋 How to Apply NBE NEET PG 2026 Online Form

        
            Visit the official website nbe.edu.in or natboard.edu.in.
            Click on the “NEET PG 2026” or “New Registration” link.
            Complete the registration by entering your name, date of birth, email ID, mobile number, and other details.
            Login with your User ID and Password to fill the online application form.
            Enter personal details, educational qualifications, internship details, and select preferred exam cities.
            Upload scanned documents (photo, signature, thumb impression, MBBS certificates, etc.) as per specifications.
            Pay the application fee online (₹3500 for General/OBC, ₹2500 for SC/ST/PwD).
            Submit the form and download/print the confirmation page for future reference.
        

        Note: Application window is open from 1st July to 21st July 2026. Read the official information brochure carefully before filling the form. Contact NBEMS helpline for any issues.

																		Short Information :
																		
																		National Board of Examination in Medical Science (NBE) has Released Official Notification for Online Application form for the National Eligibility Cum Entrance Test NEET PG 2026 for admission to various MD/MS and PG Diploma Courses 2026-27. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to NEET PG 2026 Admission . Online Apply Start On July 1, 2026 & Last Date is July 21, 2026 .All Eligible & Interested Candidate Can Read the Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in The Given Link Below
																		
																	
																
															
															 

															
																
																	
																		
																		National Board of Examination in Medical Science (NBE)

																		National Eligibility Cum Entrance Test (NEET PG-2026)
																		
																	
																	
																		WWW.RESULTBHARAT.COM
																	
																	
																		
																		Important Dates

																		
																			Online Apply Start on : 01 July 2026
																			Last Date for Apply: 21 July 2026 (11:55 PM)
																			Last Date Online Payment : 21 July 2026
																			Online Correction : 25-28 July 2026
																			Final Edit Window to rectify deficient/Incorrect Images : 31 July to 10 August 2026
																			Exam City Available : 11 August 2026
																			Admit Card Available : 27 August 2026
																			NEET PG 2026 Exam Date : 30 August 2026
																			Result Declared : 30 September 2026 (Tentative)
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Application Fee 

																		
																			General/ OBC/ EWS  : Rs. 3500/-
																			SC/ ST/ PH Candidates : Rs. 2500/-    
																			Payment Mode: Pay the Examination Fee Through Pay the Exam Fee Through Online Debit Card, Credit Card or Net Banking Fee Mode or Fee Mode. 
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Course Details

																		
																			Admission to MD/MS/PG Diploma Courses: 2026-27 session
																			Admission to Post MBBS DNB/ DrNB and NBEMS Diploma Courses-2026-27 session
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Eligibility Criteria NEET-PG 2026
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		
																			Possess MBBS degree or Provisional MBBS Pass Certificate recognized as per the provisions of the NMC Act, 2019 and the Post Graduate Medical Education Regulations, 2023,  and
																			
																			Possess Permanent or Provisional registration certificate of MBBS qualification issued by the National Medical Commission (NMC) / the erstwhile Medical Council of India (MCI) or State Medical Council,  and have completed one year of internship or are likely to complete the internship on or before 30-09-2026.
																			
																			
																			Candidates found to be ineligible at any stage of NEET-PG 2026 will not be permitted to appear in the examination and / or counseling. In an unlikely event of any ineligible candidate appearing and / or being successful in the NEET-PG 2026, the results / candidature of such candidate shall be cancelled and / or are deemed to be cancelled.
																			
																			
																			Requests for appearing in NEET-PG 2026 from candidates completing internship after 30-09-2026 or having qualifications that are not recognized as per the NMC Act, 2019 and the repealed IMC Act, 1956 shall be summarily rejected. Candidates are further advised not to canvass for the same.
																			
																		

							
																		
																	 
																	
																	
																															
															
															Image Upload Instructions

															Passport Size Photo:  

															
																Photograph is in colour with white background.
																Your face is clearly visible.
																The size of image should be less than 80kb. Size of the image can be checked by right click on the image and then go to “Properties” link. (Maintain aspectratio, i.e. height and width ratio to avoid distortion of image)
																Image is in .jpg/.jpeg format.
																Image is not blurred in the process of editing.
																Digital enhancement or other alterations or retouching are not permitted.
																Make sure your face takes up at least 70-80% of the frame.
															

															 

															Scanned Signature

															
																The candidate should provide his/her complete signatures and not just initials.
																The signatures should be done by the candidates only as it may be checked any time frequently.
																Signature done on the blank white page without lines only will be accepted
																Take the white sheet and mark the box size of 3.5 x 1.5 cm (width x height)
																Sign inside the box with blue/black pen.
																If the Candidate’s signature on the answer script, at the time of the examination, does not match the signature on the Attendance Sheet, the candidate will be disqualified.
																Set the scanner to 200 dpi
																The scanned image should be saved in .jpeg/.jpg format.
																Crop only box area and not the complete white page.
																The size of image should be less than 80kb
															

															Left Thumb Impression: 

															
																Set the scanner to 200 dpi.
																Save the scanned image of thumb-print as .jpg/.jpeg format.
																Crop only box area.
																The size of image should be less than 80kb. Size of the image can be checked by right click on the image and then go to “Properties” link.
															
															
														
														
															
															Help Desk for NEET PG 2026

															
																Helpline Number: +91-7996165333 
																Helpline Portal: (i) For queries related to application form submission/ Refund of failed transactions/ Payment Gateway related issues etc: Portal can be accessed through applicant login after registering an application for NEET-PG 2024. (ii) For queries related to Eligibility/ Documents/ Images: NBEMS Communication Web Portal accessible through NBEMS Website (Contact Us tab)
															
															
														
														
														
    
        
        📋 How to Apply NBE NEET PG 2026 Online Form

        
            Visit the official website nbe.edu.in or natboard.edu.in.
            Click on the “NEET PG 2026” or “New Registration” link.
            Complete the registration by entering your name, date of birth, email ID, mobile number, and other details.
            Login with your User ID and Password to fill the online application form.
            Enter personal details, educational qualifications, internship details, and select preferred exam cities.
            Upload scanned documents (photo, signature, thumb impression, MBBS certificates, etc.) as per specifications.
            Pay the application fee online (₹3500 for General/OBC, ₹2500 for SC/ST/PwD).
            Submit the form and download/print the confirmation page for future reference.
        

        Note: Application window is open from 1st July to 21st July 2026. Read the official information brochure carefully before filling the form. Contact NBEMS helpline for any issues.

																			General/ OBC/ EWS  : Rs. 3500/-
																			SC/ ST/ PH Candidates : Rs. 2500/-    
																			Payment Mode: Pay the Examination Fee Through Pay the Exam Fee Through Online Debit Card, Credit Card or Net Banking Fee Mode or Fee Mode. 
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Course Details

																		
																			Admission to MD/MS/PG Diploma Courses: 2026-27 session
																			Admission to Post MBBS DNB/ DrNB and NBEMS Diploma Courses-2026-27 session
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Eligibility Criteria NEET-PG 2026
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		
																			Possess MBBS degree or Provisional MBBS Pass Certificate recognized as per the provisions of the NMC Act, 2019 and the Post Graduate Medical Education Regulations, 2023,  and
																			
																			Possess Permanent or Provisional registration certificate of MBBS qualification issued by the National Medical Commission (NMC) / the erstwhile Medical Council of India (MCI) or State Medical Council,  and have completed one year of internship or are likely to complete the internship on or before 30-09-2026.
																			
																			
																			Candidates found to be ineligible at any stage of NEET-PG 2026 will not be permitted to appear in the examination and / or counseling. In an unlikely event of any ineligible candidate appearing and / or being successful in the NEET-PG 2026, the results / candidature of such candidate shall be cancelled and / or are deemed to be cancelled.
																			
																			
																			Requests for appearing in NEET-PG 2026 from candidates completing internship after 30-09-2026 or having qualifications that are not recognized as per the NMC Act, 2019 and the repealed IMC Act, 1956 shall be summarily rejected. Candidates are further advised not to canvass for the same.
																			
																		

							
																		
																	 
																	
																	
																															
															
															Image Upload Instructions

															Passport Size Photo:  

															
																Photograph is in colour with white background.
																Your face is clearly visible.
																The size of image should be less than 80kb. Size of the image can be checked by right click on the image and then go to “Properties” link. (Maintain aspectratio, i.e. height and width ratio to avoid distortion of image)
																Image is in .jpg/.jpeg format.
																Image is not blurred in the process of editing.
																Digital enhancement or other alterations or retouching are not permitted.
																Make sure your face takes up at least 70-80% of the frame.
															

															 

															Scanned Signature

															
																The candidate should provide his/her complete signatures and not just initials.
																The signatures should be done by the candidates only as it may be checked any time frequently.
																Signature done on the blank white page without lines only will be accepted
																Take the white sheet and mark the box size of 3.5 x 1.5 cm (width x height)
																Sign inside the box with blue/black pen.
																If the Candidate’s signature on the answer script, at the time of the examination, does not match the signature on the Attendance Sheet, the candidate will be disqualified.
																Set the scanner to 200 dpi
																The scanned image should be saved in .jpeg/.jpg format.
																Crop only box area and not the complete white page.
																The size of image should be less than 80kb
															

															Left Thumb Impression: 

															
																Set the scanner to 200 dpi.
																Save the scanned image of thumb-print as .jpg/.jpeg format.
																Crop only box area.
																The size of image should be less than 80kb. Size of the image can be checked by right click on the image and then go to “Properties” link.

																Helpline Number: +91-7996165333

        📋 How to Apply NBE NEET PG 2026 Online Form

        
            Visit the official website nbe.edu.in or natboard.edu.in.
            Click on the “NEET PG 2026” or “New Registration” link.
            Complete the registration by entering your name, date of birth, email ID, mobile number, and other details.
            Login with your User ID and Password to fill the online application form.
            Enter personal details, educational qualifications, internship details, and select preferred exam cities.
            Upload scanned documents (photo, signature, thumb impression, MBBS certificates, etc.) as per specifications.
            Pay the application fee online (₹3500 for General/OBC, ₹2500 for SC/ST/PwD).
            Submit the form and download/print the confirmation page for future reference.
        

        Note: Application window is open from 1st July to 21st July 2026. Read the official information brochure carefully before filling the form. Contact NBEMS helpline for any issues.
